A session is an MCP connection of `camel mcp`, and for `camel tui --mcp` the time from one `initialize` of the
+Models carry the argument names of one tool over to the next: `camel_catalog_doc` takes `name`, so a model calls
+`camel_catalog_find` with `name` or `query` instead of `term`. `camel mcp` takes these names for the ones the tool
+Another name is taken only when the call does not give the argument itself, and never when the tool has an argument
+of that name (the `name` of `camel_catalog_doc` stays its `name`). When a call gives several, the first one listed
+wins. A `path` is passed on as the `file`, as it is. The tool listing names the declared arguments only, and a JSON
+answer says which name to use the next time in its first field, `argumentNote`:
+The note also names an argument the tool does not take, which is ignored, with the arguments the tool takes:
+`ignored: bogus; camel_catalog_find takes term (required), kind, limit, camelVersion`.
+A call of any tool that misses a required argument is answered, as a tool error, with the arguments of the tool in
+the order it declares them and the ones the call gave, rather than with the name of the missing one only:
+camel_catalog_find takes term (required), kind, limit, camelVersion; got q
+`camel ask` (see xref:camel-jbang-ai.adoc[]) takes the same names, and adds the same note to its JSON answers.
